_: Counters that may only DECREASE. Replaces editable allowlists: an allowlist grows monotonically, a ratchet shrinks. Recompute with the commands in _commands. See .local/final-review/05-quality-gates.md.

_commands.untaggedRunGracePaths: grep -c 'isWithinUntaggedGraceWindow(run.createdAt)' src/shared/jobs/owned-run.ts   # remove the grace branch one deploy cycle after tagging ships, then 0
_commands.routesTakingProjectIdWithoutOwnershipChe: for f in $(find src/app/api -name route.ts); do grep -qE 'projectId|project_id' "$f" && ! grep -rqE 'verifyProjectAccess|verifyEpisodeAccess|verifyBeatAccess|verifyCharacterAccess|verifyProjectOwnership|listForUser|session\.user\.id|isAdminUser' "$(dirname "$f")" && echo "$f"; done | wc -l
_commands.sessionExistenceOnlyRoutes: grep -rl 'auth-scope: session-existence-only' src/app/api --include='*.ts' | wc -l   # each is a reviewed decision; the number should not grow
